en: The postcard consists of two sides. The address side features a Swedish 5 öre stamp, cancellation mark, and handwritten address, using old-style Swedish and French ('BREFKORT. (CARTE POSTALE.)') printed text. The image side is a black and white photograph of a city harbor scene, with large sailing ships docked along the waterfront and multi-story buildings visible in the background. There is printed text reading 'Hamnen Sundsvall' (Swedish for 'The Harbor, Sundsvall') and publisher information. Handwritten Swedish text is present at the bottom.
